title: NOA Manifest-Signer Delegation
description: Offline Tenant Root Authority-signed delegation (D16-v2, §9): grants a delegated key the key-manifest-sign permission and, since S5, optionally the action-class-enrol permission that authorizes it to sign the action-class enrolment registry. Domain NOA-KeyDelegation-v0.1-sig. Signed by the tenant root (e.g. tenant-authority-1), never the gate. Alpha requires ≥1 static root-signed delegation (F11/F21). FORWARD COMPATIBILITY, stated rather than discovered: old delegations keep validating everywhere, but a delegation carrying the NEW permission does NOT validate against a pre-S5 verifier, whose enum has one member. The permission is therefore added only to the delegations that need it.
